name: Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Mends faults of the original AstroPop Deluxe and leaves the game as it was: its rules, scores, look, sounds and pace. Each fix is a toggle; turn the whole mod off to play the original exactly as it was.

settings.label: The weapon box's OK makes no sound
settings.help: The box that explains a new weapon plays the one-second timer's tick when its OK button is clicked, a sound the box has no use for (the original plays whichever sound is number 0 in its table). On: OK closes the box in silence.
